title: Saudi Arabia's escalation against the Houthis is unlikely to deliver victory, says Danny Citrinowicz
gist: In an Al-Monitor podcast with Amberin Zaman, Israeli Iran expert Danny Citrinowicz argues Saudi Arabia's escalation against Yemen's Houthis is unlikely to deliver victory, and that while the US blockade and sanctions on Iran have been effective they have not changed Tehran's calculations, leaving high risk of further escalation amid the unresolved Strait of Hormuz standoff.
